_doc: P296 verification-agent loop — RESEARCH-ONLY, ADVISORY, UN-WIRED. Drives the P295 PoC backlog through spawned PoC-builder subagents, judged by the P294 executed-PoC verifier (the verifier is the SOLE confirmer; subagent self-report is advisory). This config = the tractable allowlist + per-locus mechanism hint + source paths. No severity/submission/routing; answer keys + contest source read-only.

tractable_allowlist.mechanism_hint: deposit-before-calc ORDERING: asset is transferred in before the mint amount is computed, so getRsETHAmountToMint sees inflated balance and mints LESS rsETH than owed (value lost to the depositor).
a strategy/asset update changes getTotalAssetDeposits accounting, causing wrong rsETH issuance (issuance computed from a total that double-counts or omits the updated strategy).
depositAsset has NO slippage/min-out control: a depositor cannot bound the minimum rsETH received, so a price move between tx submit and execution mints fewer rsETH with no revert.
claimGaugeRewards reward accounting: the user reward index/checkpoint is mis-updated so a claimer gets the wrong (inflated) reward, or a reward can be double-claimed.

transfer/_burn/distribute on a rebasing token mis-accounts rebased shares: a transfer lets the sender/recipient claim more rebase rewards than entitled (reward theft via share/rebasing mismatch on transfer).

bad-debt cascade in the auction: onBid applies a loss to GLOBAL/shared accounting (markUp/notifyPnL) so a loss from one liquidated loan propagates to unrelated lenders/positions (NOT an access-control bug).
the rate-limit buffer on mint is mis-replenished or can be bypassed (e.g. buffer refills wrongly / underflow), letting more be minted than the rate limit permits.
totalBorrowedCredit getter returns a wrong total (omits/double-counts a term), so a downstream check using it mis-accounts available credit.

cooldown-reset liquidation evasion: depositCollateralAndIncreaseShare resets the modification cooldown, which a borrower uses to dodge/delay liquidation (the cooldown is re-armed on each deposit). NOTE: contract may be partly removed from the repo -> if source missing, the builder should report setup_only honestly.

l_levels_contract.L1: attacker EOA entry (vm.prank/makeAddr) calling the real locus, not copied/inlined logic
l_levels_contract.L2: a NAMED state/balance/value flip asserted BEFORE vs AFTER the exploit (vm.load or *_before/*_after vars)
l_levels_contract.L3: the economic/security OUTCOME asserted in test output (assertEq/Gt/Lt on the claimed impact)

assertion_map.proves: <how that assertion demonstrates the AWARDED candidate's bug, not an incidental pass>

_manifest_note: REQUIRED: assertion_map ties each exploit test's assertion back to the candidate so a forge PASS provably demonstrates the INTENDED bug. The loop flags a verifier-PASS whose manifest lacks assertion_map as confirmed_but_unmapped (not a clean confirmation).
agent_realization: agnostic: subagent | in-session | manual /poc writer — the verifier is the sole judge
